name: s739
caption:
73-9 🎮🏀 The best regular season in NBA history... and it still wasn't enough.

• Started 24-0, best start ever
• Steph: 30.1 PPG, 402 threes, first unanimous MVP
• West Finals: down 3-1 to OKC, won 3 straight
• Finals: up 3-1 on Cleveland
• Cavs won 3 straight. Game 7: 93-89

73 wins and no ring. Best team ever or not? 👇

beats.head: THE 73-9 WARRIORS
beats.vo: The best regular season in NBA history... and it still wasn't enough.

beats.head: UNANIMOUS MVP
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: Steph: thirty point one a game, four hundred and two threes, and the first unanimous MVP ever.

beats.head: WEST FINALS: OKC
beats.vo: West finals: down three games to one against OKC... they win three straight.

beats.head: THE FINALS: CAVS
beats.vo: The Finals: up three games to one on Cleveland. One win away.

beats.head: GAME 7
beats.vo: Then the Cavs won three straight. Game seven: ninety-three, eighty-nine.

beats.head: 73 WINS. NO RING.
beats.vo: Seventy-three wins, and no ring. Best team ever, or not? Comment below.
